PMK.Title: Marketplace

PMK.StatusHiddenMarket: Hidden from players (the market is hidden)
PMK.TipVisible: Players see and browse this market
PMK.TipOpen: Players can buy and sell here

PMK.CopyLink: Copy a journal link to this shop

PMK.DragMerchantHint: Drag a merchant here to add it, or use Add a merchant.

PMK.HaggleNotCounted: That haggle roll doesn't count. Roll again from the shop.
PMK.TipShopHidden: Hidden from players, even in a visible market
PMK.TipShopShown: Players see this shop when its market is visible
PMK.TipShopClosed: Closed: players can browse it but not trade, even in an open market
PMK.TipShopOpen: Players can trade here when its market is open
PMK.TipFillOff: Off: the PF2e system's treasure table couldn't be read
PMK.TipRestock: Staples back, rotating stock drawn again, purse filled
PMK.TipAddItem: Find an item in the equipment compendium and stock it (or drag items onto the shop)
PMK.KeeperHint: Drop an NPC here for a shopkeeper, or items to stock (Settings and Add item do the same).
PMK.StaplesOnly: Staples only: the stock has changed since your last visit.
PMK.HoldsOne: holds {n} item; not for sale as it is
PMK.HoldsMany: holds {n} items; not for sale as it is
PMK.FormulaNoPrice: No price: the PF2e system's treasure table couldn't be read

PMK.TipRotating: Cleared on a restock. Click: staple.
PMK.TipSoldOne: Sold by a player; gone after 1 more restock. Click: staple.
PMK.TipSoldMany: Sold by a player; gone after {n} more restocks. Click: staple.
PMK.TipFormulaOn: Sold as a formula at {price}. Click: sell the item. The pencil sets the price.
PMK.TipFormulaNoPrice: Sold as a formula, with no price for its level (set one with the pencil). Click: sell the item.

PMK.WholeStack: has attached parts: goes as its whole stack
PMK.NoCharacter: You have no character to trade for.
PMK.NeedGM: A GM needs to be logged in to trade.
PMK.FixLinesFirst: Fix the lines marked above first.
PMK.AnyoneCoinsOnly: An offer for anyone can only ask for coins.
PMK.ClearLogText: Clear every entry in the trade log? This can't be undone.
PMK.NoVaultsYet: No one has a vault here yet.
PMK.VaultClosedNow: The market is closed: the vault can be reached only while it's open.
PMK.VaultMarketClosed: {market} is closed: the vault can be reached only while it's open.
PMK.VaultNothing: Pick something or some coins first.
PMK.VaultCantDeposit: {name} can't go into the vault as it is.

PMK.VaultWithdrew: {name} took things from their vault at {market}.

PMK.ParchmentText: A formula for {link}, also in the Crafting tab.

PMK.WhyGrantedTrade: Not yours to trade (temporary, or granted by a feature).

PMK.NoEntryPriced: {name} has no compendium entry; priced at {price}
PMK.CantTradeFor: you can't trade for that character.

PMK.OfferedGone: something you offered isn't in your inventory any more.
PMK.IdentifyFirst: identify it before you sell it.

PMK.NotEnoughFor: {name} hasn't enough money: the trade costs {amount}.
PMK.MoneyDidntArrive: Part of the money didn't arrive; the GM has been told.
PMK.Changed: the stock or your inventory changed. Check the cart and try again.
PMK.InventoryChanged: an inventory changed. Look at the offer again.
PMK.PosterGone: The character who posted it is gone.
PMK.OfferedChanged: Something offered has changed since the offer went up. It needs posting again.
PMK.AskedChanged: Something asked for has changed since the offer went up. It needs posting again.
PMK.OfferNeedsSomething: an offer needs something offered or asked for (a gift of coins alone isn't an offer).
PMK.CantPostFor: you can't post for that character.
PMK.PartsOfferAll: {name} has attached parts: offer all {n} or none.
PMK.PartsAskAll: {name} has attached parts: ask for all {n} or none.
PMK.PostFull: the Trade Post is full. Ask the GM to clear some offers.
PMK.OfferUp: {name}'s offer is up at the Trade Post.
PMK.GMNotAnswered: the GM's client hasn't answered yet. Check your inventory before trying again.
PMK.DidntWork: that didn't work. See the console.
PMK.FailedPartway: that didn't work ({error}). Check your inventory.
PMK.PlayerTradeFailed: a request by {name} failed partway. See the console.
PMK.CartChanged: the cart changed. Check the new total and trade again.
PMK.TradeFailedPartway: the trade failed partway. See the console.
PMK.FormulaLinesSkipped: {shop}: {n} formula line(s) skipped. Formulas have no price while the PF2e system's treasure table can't be read.
PMK.AddLinesFirst: add rotating stock lines in the shop's Settings first.
PMK.NothingToDraw: nothing to draw at this shop's level.
PMK.RestockSummary: {staples} staples refilled · {rotating} rotating cleared · sold items: {soldGo} go, {soldStay} stay · about {lines} new drawn; purses filled.
PMK.KindPick: (pick one to fill in its lines)
PMK.LevelHint: At 0 the shop takes its market's level. The level sets how full Fill purse makes it, and the DC to haggle.
PMK.LevelHintMarket: At 0 the shop takes its market's level ({level}). The level sets how full Fill purse makes it, and the DC to haggle.
PMK.PaysItems: Pays for items (% of their price)
PMK.PaysTreasure: Pays for treasure (% of its value)
PMK.UnlimitedPurse: Unlimited purse (never runs out of money)
PMK.AttitudeHint: Attitude changes what players pay (the module settings say by how much).
PMK.AttitudeHintModule: The shopkeeper's attitude in NPC Attitudes counts first (toward each character, if set). If the party is shown a different attitude than the real one, prices are normal. This one is used when they have no attitude there.
PMK.RotatingStock: Rotating stock (drawn up to the shop's level)
PMK.ServicesHint: Things the shop does rather than sells (lodging, a crossing, a repair). Bought with coins, as often as wanted.
PMK.Name: Name
PMK.NewShopHint: A PF2e merchant is made in this market's folder and its sheet opens, so you can drag in its stock.
PMK.ReputationNone: PF2e Campaign Trackers has no reputation trackers yet.
PMK.ReputationHint: Each tier of the tracker moves prices here by a percent, on top of attitude. Off when Campaign Trackers isn't on.
PMK.PicturePh: A banner or map of the market
PMK.FolderNew: A new folder named after the market
PMK.FolderHint: Every PF2e merchant in this folder (and the folders inside it) is a shop in the market.
PMK.MarketPctHint: Every shop here, for buying, on top of the shopkeeper's attitude. Positive costs more.
PMK.VaultsOn: Characters can keep things in a vault here
PMK.VaultsHint: Each character's own storage, reached only from this market while it's open.
PMK.FormulaBlank: Blank: {price}, the price for its level.
PMK.FormulaBlankNone: Blank: the price for its level (none now: the PF2e system's treasure table couldn't be read).
PMK.AddItemType: Type part of an item's name.
PMK.AddItemPickOne: pick an item from the list first.
PMK.NoMerchantsToAdd: every merchant is in this market already.
PMK.KeeperFromTab: drag an NPC from the Actors tab (import a compendium actor first).
PMK.KeeperIsNPC: a shopkeeper is an NPC actor.
PMK.StocksPhysical: a shop stocks physical items (not coins, nor a container with things in it).
PMK.MerchantFromTab: drag a merchant from the Actors tab (import a compendium actor first).
PMK.OnlyMerchants: only PF2e merchants can be shops: a loot actor with its sheet set to Merchant.
PMK.ShopNotOpenNow: this shop isn't open for trade right now.
PMK.CartFull: the cart is full ({n} lines). Trade or take something out first.
PMK.MakeStapleFirst: make it a staple or rotating first.
PMK.NoFormulaSource: this item has no compendium or Items-tab entry, so a formula of it would have nothing to point to. Drag it in from the compendium or the Items tab.
PMK.NowOfferedTo: {name} is now offered to {shop} instead of {other}.
PMK.OfferNeedsSomethingNotice: offer something (items or coins), and ask for something unless you're giving items away.
PMK.FillOff: Fill purse is off: the PF2e system's treasure table couldn't be read.
PMK.DeleteMarketText: Delete the market {name}? Its merchants and their folder stay; only the market goes.
PMK.MarketClosedText: {name} is closed, so players can't trade here. Open the market too?
PMK.MarketHiddenText: {name} is hidden, so players can't see this shop. Show the market too?
PMK.OpenShop: Open the shop in the Marketplace
PMK.LinkNotVisible: that shop or market isn't one you can visit now.

Setting.OpenFromTokenHint: On: a player who double-clicks a merchant's token, or opens its sheet, gets its shop in the Marketplace (when the shop is in a market they can see). GMs always get the sheet; the token HUD has a button for the shop.
Setting.ReceiptsHint: A receipt in chat after each trade at a shop: what was bought and sold, and the coins.
Setting.ReceiptsWhisper: To the trader's owners and the GMs
Setting.AmountHint: How many items a rotating stock line of this size draws, as a range ("1-3") or one number.
Setting.StackRangeHint: How many of each consumable, bomb or ammunition a draw gives a shop, as a range ("1-4"), in batches (10 arrows).
Setting.PurseScaleHint: How full Fill purse (and a new shop) makes a shop's purse: 100% is one level's party treasure for the shop's level, read from the PF2e system, and 100 gp below level 1. Lower it for a poor region, raise it for a rich one.

Formula.uncommonHint: Multiplies the price of an uncommon formula (the price for its level is for common formulas).
Formula.rareHint: Multiplies the price of a rare formula.

Setting.HostileRefusesHint: On: a hostile shopkeeper won't buy or sell at all. Off: they trade at the Hostile price change below.
Setting.PriceHintFirst: What players pay when buying from a shopkeeper with this attitude, in percent: positive costs more, negative is a discount. Treasure is never discounted. What a shop pays doesn't change, except that it never pays more than it would charge.
Setting.PriceHint: Positive costs more, negative is a discount (buying only).
Setting.HagglingHint: On: a character can try Diplomacy once at each shop until its next restock, against the DC for the shop's level, to change what they pay there.
Setting.HaggleHint: What a haggle does to that character's prices at that shop (buying only), until its next restock: negative is a discount.
Setting.HotkeyHint: Opens the Marketplace window, or brings it to the front.

PMK.HaggleWaiting: {name}'s haggle at {shop} is still on its way to the GM.
PMK.PlayerRulesFailed: {name}'s client couldn't read the PF2e system's rules tables, so formula prices and haggling are off for them. See their console.
PMK.PlayerTreasureFailed: {name}'s client couldn't read the PF2e system's treasure table, so formula prices are off for them. See their console.
PMK.PlayerDCsFailed: {name}'s client couldn't read the PF2e system's DCs by level, so haggling is off for them. See their console.
